provenance: All source text and numbers in this runnable fixture are synthetic; they are not published experiments or benchmark results.

excerpts.text: In a synthetic bench exercise, catalyst X raised product yield from 31% without catalyst to 72% with catalyst after 20 minutes at 25 °C. The team repeated each condition three times under the same workup procedure. Long-term catalyst stability and yields at other temperatures were not tested.

In this synthetic storage exercise, formulation F retained 92% of its initial assay after 7 days at 4 °C and 74% after 7 days at 25 °C. Samples were protected from light and tested in duplicate. The exercise did not measure 28-day retention, microbial stability, or performance after freeze-thaw cycles.
